scope: Corollary 5.3 (Fixed quenched tests) of the manuscript “Quenched SLE Universality for Weakly Disordered FK–Ising Interfaces” (preprints/Quenched-SLE-Universality-for-Weakly-Disordered-FK-Ising-Interfaces-October-5-2026/quenched-fk-ising.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c054f7856b32267e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 25. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each fixed polygon P in Proposition 5.2, assign to every lifted edge the random odds of its projected edge. At the critical inverse temperature of Theorem 1.1, the separately wired actual crossing probability tends in environmental probability to g(χP ). The open-cap probability tends to f(χP ).
